svg.title: Color wheel pairings for sky blue travel app
svg.desc: Color wheel showing complementary, analogous, and accent color relationships for a sky blue palette
svg.text: These sit right next to blue. Safe, harmonious, dreamy.
Use for: background washes, illustrated map layers, category tags
Warm oranges & corals sit directly across from blue. Great for CTAs and accents.
Use for: CTA buttons, notification badges, map destination pins, friend invite highlights
Cool-tinted neutrals that feel native to a sky blue world.
Use for: body text, card borders, secondary UI, disabled states
